Transcriptomic Changes in Microdissected CTALs after Three Hours Unilateral Ureteral Obstruction (UUO) in Rats

Brief methods: Cortical thick ascending limbs were microdissected from the ipsilateral kidney 3 hours after left unilateral ureteral obstruction or sham surgery (n=4 versus n=4, paired). Microdissected tubules were subjected to small sample RNA-Seq analysis as previously described (PMID: 31146973).

This website was created by Chih-Chien Sung, Brian Poll, Mark Knepper, and Chin-Rang Yang. Contact us with questions or comments: knep@helix.nih.gov. Database updated: November 26, 2021

TPM, mRNA level in transcripts per million. Log2(UUO/Sham) is base 2 logarithm of the UUO to Sham TPM ratio. Shades of green indicate increased Log2(UUO/Sham). Shades of blue indicate decreased Log2(UUO/Sham). Yellow indicates P<0.05 based on t-statistic for Log2(UUO/Sham) versus 0. Click here to download data. Please cite: Sung et al., 2022. PMID:36264882.
